title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 5. Encourages the EU and its Member States to work, in the context of this strategy, towards a common approach to the Muslim Brotherhood and supporting organisations affiliated with it, starting with agreeing on a shared understanding of the key dimensions of the movement, building upon existing national intelligence service reports, including assessments of its organisational characteristics, structural features and ideological foundations; considers that this could then lead to the development of a European common analytical methodology for assessing links between specific organisations or individuals and the movement, notably based on financial opacity, the recurrence of certain partnerships, proximity to already identified networks;
